name: Dear my Sweet Devil II
source:
"Will you always stay in my sunshine?"

I want to say it but I cannot. I want to touch her but I cannot.
All of it that has been given, my standing, my fate... and my crime.
She is the one I love. I want to protect her.
Even if she is the devil...

Dear my Sweet Devil II...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077566.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“你愿意一直留在我的阳光里吗？”

想说，却说不出口。想触碰她，却无法伸手。
被赋予我的一切，我的立场、我的命运……还有我的罪。
她是我所爱的人。我想保护她。
即使她是恶魔……

Dear my Sweet Devil II……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077566.html]DLsite English[/url]]
